text:
ravi_ops: Postmortem follow-up: persistent noisy 403 pages from model-proxy. Need owners for: dedupe key, threshold tuning, short suppression window, canary, and monthly churn audit. Tracker: https://go/rems/403-remediate

sam_oncall: I'll own dedupe key + suppression window. Proposal: key = client_id:endpoint:hex(hash(body)[:6]), suppression 3m. Will test in staging.

hana_sre: I'll take thresholds + monthly audit. Plan: raise client-scoped alert threshold 15% then observe 7d; add global p99 spike alert.

dave_dev: I'll implement hash util and add unit tests. Recommend including path and first 48 bytes of body in hash input. ETA 4 days.

pager-bot: Incident 2026-10-12: model-proxy 403 spike -> 27 pages, peak 01:42 UTC.

claire_prod: Suggest canary rollout: staging -> 5% prod for 48h -> full. I'll coordinate outreach for top noisy clients.

sam_oncall: Draft alert (staging):
```
alert: ModelProxyAuthSpike
expr: sum(rate(model_proxy_responses_total{status=~"4.."}[5m])) by (client_id, endpoint) > 35
for: 2m
annotations:
  runbook: "/runbooks/model-proxy-403.md"
```
Paging dedupe config: key: "{{client_id}}:{{endpoint}}:{{hash(body,6)}}" suppression_window: 180s

ravi_ops: Owners + ETAs: sam 10d (dedupe+suppress), hana 14d (thresholds+audit), dave 4d (hash util), claire 7d (canary+client coord). Add GH issues tagged pm-followup/alert-tuning and link to tracker. Sync Friday 09:30 UTC.

dave_dev: PR for hash util in progress, tests included.

hana_sre: I'll add dashboards to show unique dedupe keys and pages/day to measure impact.

claire_prod: Reached out to top 3 noisy clients.

sam_oncall: Will open PR for alert changes and paging config. Marking WIP.

ravi_ops: If canary shows >65% page reduction over 48h we close the short-term actions. Ping me if blocked.
